name: editor-apprentice
description: Teach Claude how you edit. Claude asks how you work with each client, splits your workflow into stages, helps on the stages you hand over (one at a time, under your corrections), learns from your final cut, and writes it all into an editor skill plus one skill per client. Any editing or motion app: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut and more — through project files, scripting, MCP servers or computer use, in any language.
